semantics.adapter_rule: Adapter translates or mounts declared surfaces; it does not become semantic owner of source/target data.
semantics.command_rule: Adapter has no independent hidden command authority.
semantics.identity_rule: Adapter identity is explicit and independent from its mount location.
semantics.binding_rule: Source and target refs are explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Adapter availability does not grant source/target access authority.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself does not create new authority.

hard_gates.condition: Adapter becomes semantic owner of translated source
